description: Make a PDF from images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, AVIF, SVG…), one image per page, in the order given. Page size A4, Letter, or "fit" (page = image size at 96 dpi); orientation auto/portrait/landscape; margin in mm; quality "original" (JPEG/PNG kept as-is), high (≤3000 px, JPEG 90), medium (≤2000 px, 75) or small (≤1400 px, 60). Photos are turned upright from their EXIF orientation. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/images-to-pdf/

images.description: Images in page order: path/base64 strings, or {file, rotate}.

anyOf.description: The image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

file.description: The image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

margin.description: Margin around each image in mm. Default 10.

orientation.description: "auto" turns the page to match each image. Ignored for "fit".

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

name: pdf_from_images
title: Images to PDF
